note: Belarus: Russians move freely; nationals of the countries listed enter without a visa for 90 or 30 days, and under a temporary regime to 31 December 2026 the EU, EFTA, the UK and the European microstates for 30 days; nationals of the e-Visa list apply online (30 days), the conditional e-Visa nationalities only with a Schengen, Cypriot or Irish visa (not modelled). Everyone else needs a visa. Read from Wikipedia's copy.
